records.text: A Wilmington tipster asserted that the FBI had hidden offices, maybe in buildings that appear to be partly controlled by French-American families who might have conflicted interests, particularly the DuPont family.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep a-e7HC6SeK8)

appearances.snippet: Because our tip yesterday from that person in Wilmington, Delaware, was asserting that the FBI had these offices—these kind of hidden offices—maybe kind of in buildings that appear to be in part controlled by French American families who might have some conflicted interests, particularly we were discussing the DuPont family, right?
